questions.stem: Avec l’indice «Identify why false claims spread faster than corrections / Compare novelty and emotion of each message. / How a false claim…», quelle option est réellement appuyée par le texte ?

questions.stem: Avec «Evaluate a rule about anonymous accounts / Anonymity has protective uses too. / A digital-citizenship rule» en téte, quelle option est conforme au texte ?

options.text: Yes, anonymity always enables harm
options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "Yes, anonymity always enables harm" for the governing rule

options.text: No, because rules never matter
Yes, because platforms know best
No, anonymity also protects vulnerable users

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: anonymity can protect vulnerable users, so a total ban is unsound. On that basis "No, anonymity also protects vulnerable users" is the supported choice. Option A ("Yes, anonymity always enables harm") fails because it mistakes a surface feature of "Yes, anonymity always enables harm" for the governing rule; Option B ("No, because rules never matter") fails because it dismisses all rules; Option C ("Yes, because platforms know best") fails because it overtrusts platforms.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Why a deleted post still counts as a trace
questions.learningObjective: Identify the most persistent trace type

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: La consigne de cet item est «Identify the most persistent trace type / Distributed user copies persist most. / Why a deleted post still counts as a trace». Quelle réponse en découle ?

options.text: A screenshot saved on many devices
The platform's internal log
The author's draft folder
A temporary cache entry
options.misconception: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: screenshots on many devices are distributed and hard to recall. On that basis "A screenshot saved on many devices" is the supported choice. Option B ("The platform's internal log") fails because it platform logs can be purged; Option C ("The author's draft folder") fails because it drafts are local and removable; Option D ("A temporary cache entry") fails because it substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for why a deleted post still counts as a trace.

questions.topic: How a false claim travels furthest
questions.learningObjective: Explain why emotion beats accuracy in spread

stimulus.body: L'extrait ci-dessous sert à vérifier la compréhension de cette forme. Parmi les quatre réponses, une seule s'appuie sur le texte lui-même.

questions.stem: Avec «Explain why emotion beats accuracy in spread / Emotion triggers sharing before verification. / How a false claim travels furthest» en téte, quelle option est conforme au texte ?

answer.exemplar: Emotional content triggers quick sharing before verification, while accurate but dry content rarely spreads as fast because it lacks urgency.

questions.explanation: Emotion drives quick sharing before verification; dry accuracy lacks urgency. The tempting belief that truth spreads itself ignores emotion.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Why a convincing forgery is hard to call
questions.learningObjective: Select the best verification channel

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: La consigne de cet item est «Select the best verification channel / Type the official address yourself. / Why a convincing forgery is hard to call». Quelle réponse en découle ?

options.text: Click the link to check quickly
Forward it to friends for opinions
Ignore and go to the official site directly
Reply to the notice asking if real

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: going directly to the official site avoids lookalike domains. On that basis "Ignore and go to the official site directly" is the supported choice. Option A ("Click the link to check quickly") fails because it risks phishing via lookalike domain; Option B ("Forward it to friends for opinions") fails because it spreads potential forgery; Option D ("Reply to the notice asking if real") fails because it may engage the forger.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: What a screen-time report counts
questions.learningObjective: Create a personal screen-time goal

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: En appliquant «Create a personal screen-time goal / Target distractions and sleep. / What a screen-time report counts» au fragment, quelle option se justifie ?

options.text: Reduce total minutes to zero
Disable all notifications forever
Match a friend's lower number
Limit distracting apps and protect sleep

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: limiting distractions and protecting sleep targets meaningful use. On that basis "Limit distracting apps and protect sleep" is the supported choice. Option A ("Reduce total minutes to zero") fails because it unrealistic and ignores utility; Option B ("Disable all notifications forever") fails because it overcorrects and loses alerts; Option C ("Match a friend's lower number") fails because it compares without context.
